text:
marie (eng-runtime): FYI seeing ~12% median token latency bump on /chat/compose after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. KV eviction rate jumped on canary nodes. Repro on canary at 10% traffic.

aditya (eng-platform): looking at the per-token dashboard: https://console.redwood/dash/route-token-breakdown?route=/chat/compose - KV miss tail pushed up, token decode time increased.

sam (eng-ml): did we change the batching/window heuristics in the selector? I remember a commit that tightened max batch wait to favor lower p99 but smaller batches -> more kernel fallbacks. commit 4f2b9a3.

li (eng-runtime): I pushed that selector tweak. It forces earlier kernel selection decision w/ shorter wait (16ms). I can roll a revert to the previous 32ms window if we want to test.

marie (eng-runtime): yes please start a revert canary. Also we need KV cache traces — evictions look correlated with those smaller batches, maybe KV warming/placement issues.

sam (eng-ml): quick profiler snippet from a slow trace (timestamps are relative ms):
```
trace_id=tz-8812
seq_len=1024
kernel_chosen=fast_fp16 (fallbacks=1)
kv_evictions=18
kv_miss_ms=4.3
decode_token_ms=2.7
other_kernel_fallbacks=7
```
baseline for same load: kv_evictions=1, kv_miss_ms=0.4, decode_token_ms=1.8

toni (eng-infra): infra saw memory churn on the canary pool around the same window. kube OOMs? Not full OOM but cache GC cycles triggered frequently. Node metrics: free_mem dropped 30% and pagecache thrash increased.

nora (eng-sre): opened incident INC-2026-0812 and hooked pager. If revert doesn't reduce p50/p95 within next 30m we'll escalate. Setting alert: token_lat_diff > 8% over 10m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed at 2012345775 by li (rollout: kernel-selector-revert-candidate).

li (eng-runtime): revert canary at 10% now. watching kv_eviction rate and kernel_choice distribution.

marie (eng-runtime): initial numbers: kv_evictions dropped from ~420/min -> ~32/min on revert canary nodes, median token latency trending back down but still catching up due to warmed caches.

aditya (eng-platform): thanks — ringing this into dashboards: I'll add a per-route unit-econ panel (tokens -> GPU_ms -> $/1000 tokens) and annotate the selector change and canary revert. We need to reconcile billing when kernel fallbacks artificially inflate token GPU time.

sam (eng-ml): agreed — kernel fallback should be accounted as an orthogonal field in token accounting so billing and cost-per-token views show an adjusted and raw number. I'll open an eval to measure fallback penalty across seq lengths.

marie (eng-runtime): next steps: 1) keep revert canary at 10% -> 50% if stable, 2) collect full KV cache traces for 10 slow requests, 3) run offline microbench of selector commit across seq_len distribution (64/256/1024).

aditya (eng-platform): I'll schedule a short dashboard patch and add an annotation for commit 4f2b9a3 + revert. Also will add a metric panel for kernel_fallback_rate per-route.

marie (eng-runtime): thanks all. Ping me when canary reaches 50% or if p50/p95 regresses after warmed caches. :thumbsup:
